title: Disable a charger in Charger Selection so a specific AGV can be manually pushed into the disabled charging station
summary: Use the Charger Selection interface to disable a specific charging station so RMS will not route other AGVs to that charger. Then physically push the desired AGV into the disabled charging station for manual charging. Afterward, re-enable the charger so normal charging availability resumes.
when_to_use: When you need to reserve a charging station for manual charging of a specific AGV by preventing RMS from routing other AGVs to that charger.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute charger disable/enable actions in Charger Selection and verify the charger is disabled/enabled as intended.
safety_notes: After manual charging, ensure the charger is turned back on/enabled; leaving a charger disabled can reduce charging capacity at sites with limited chargers.
access_or_tools_needed: Ability to disable/enable a charger from Charger Selection
Physical access to the AGV and the charging station

system_preconditions: Charger Selection interface is available to use for viewing charger status (enabled/disabled) and disabling/enabling a charger.

visual_references.description: Charger Selection screen frame showing charger selection and the disabled function concept (status enabled/disabled; disable logically disables allocation).
Charger Selection slide frame including the statement that a charger can be disabled for manual charging and reminder to turn the charger back on afterward.

steps.title: Open the Charger Selection screen/interface
steps.purpose: Access the interface needed to view charger status and disable/enable a specific charger for manual charging reservation.
steps.expected_result: Charger Selection is open and you can select a charger to view charger information/status (enabled or disabled).
steps.healthy_condition: You can see charger entries and charger status (enabled/disabled) within Charger Selection.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot view charger status or cannot access the disable/enable control for a charger.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: 'Charger Selection... If you need to use a charger to manually charge a robot you can disable a charger so that no other robot is sent to that charger. Once the charger is disable, desired AGV can be pushed in to the disabled charging station.'

steps.title: Select the charger you need for manual charging
steps.purpose: Identify the specific charging station (charger) to reserve by disabling it.
steps.instruction: In Charger Selection, select the charger you need to use for manual charging so you can view its charger information/status.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger’s information/status is shown (including whether it is enabled or disabled).
steps.healthy_condition: Charger Selection shows the selected charger and its status (enabled/disabled).
steps.failure_condition: You select the wrong charger or cannot confirm the charger’s enabled/disabled status.

actions.label: Select charger
actions.exact_action: Select the charger you need to use for manual charging (select a charger to view charger information/status).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text includes 'Charger Selection... select a charger to view charger...' and 'Is that charger enabled or disabled, right?' (from nearby transcript).
Nearby transcript: 'in the charge selection, you'll see... if you click on the charger, you can see the status of the charger. Is that charger enabled or disabled, right?'

steps.title: Disable the selected charger to reserve the station
steps.purpose: Prevent RMS from routing any other AGVs to that charging location so the desired AGV can be manually pushed in.
steps.instruction: Use the disable control/state in Charger Selection to disable the selected charger.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger is disabled in Charger Selection, and RMS will not route any AGVs to charge in that charging location (disabled for that allocation).
steps.healthy_condition: Charger Selection shows the charger as disabled (not enabled), indicating it is logically disabled for allocation.
steps.failure_condition: Other robots/AGVs are still being sent to the charger despite the disable action.

actions.label: Disable charger
actions.exact_action: Disable the selected charger so that no other robot is sent to that charger (disable function in Charger Selection).

stop_or_escalate_if: If other robots are still being sent to the charger, re-check that the charger is actually disabled in Charger Selection.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: 'If you need to use a charger to manually charge a robot you can disable a charger so that no other robot is sent to that charger.'
Nearby transcript: 'you'll see a disabled function... That means when you click disable, RMS will not route any AGVS to charge in that charging location. It's disabled for that allocation.'

steps.title: Push the desired AGV into the disabled charging station
steps.purpose: Physically place the target AGV into the reserved (disabled) charging station for manual charging.
steps.instruction: Once the charger is disabled, physically push the desired AGV into the disabled charging station corresponding to that charger.
steps.expected_result: The desired AGV is physically positioned in the disabled charging station so manual charging can proceed.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is at the charging station that corresponds to the charger you disabled in Charger Selection.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is not placed into the intended disabled charging station (wrong station) or the station is not reserved (charger not actually disabled).

actions.label: Push AGV into disabled charger
actions.exact_action: Once the charger is disable, desired AGV can be pushed in to the disabled charging station.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the charger was not actually disabled, stop and re-check the charger disabled state in Charger Selection before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: 'Once the charger is disable, desired AGV can be pushed in to the disabled charging station.'

steps.title: Re-enable the charger after manual charging
steps.purpose: Restore normal charging availability by enabling the charger again after the manual charging use is complete.
steps.instruction: After manual charging use, ensure the charger is turned back on/enabled in Charger Selection.
steps.expected_result: The charger shows as enabled in Charger Selection so RMS/WCS can again assign AGVs in the charging queue to use that charger.
steps.healthy_condition: Charger Selection indicates the charger is enabled (not disabled).
steps.failure_condition: The charger remains disabled after manual charging, reducing charging capacity (especially on sites with limited chargers).

actions.label: Enable charger
actions.exact_action: Turn the charger back on/enabled (re-enable this charging location).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot re-enable the charger after manual charging, escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript includes: 'just make sure that once we take it off, we turn the charger back on... if over here we only have like 2 chargers and you turn keep one off and forgot to enable it... everything is just using 1 charger and it's gonna take a long time.'
Nearby transcript: 'And then you can re enable this charging location that will allow RMS and WCS to again assigning Agvs that are in the charging queue to use that charger.'

success_criteria: Charger Selection shows the selected charger as disabled during manual charging so RMS does not route other AGVs to that charging location.
The desired AGV is physically pushed into the disabled charging station.
After manual charging, the charger is re-enabled in Charger Selection so charging availability returns.
healthy_conditions: Charger Selection indicates the charger’s enabled/disabled status correctly.
No other AGVs are routed to the disabled charging location while it is disabled.
After re-enable, the charger is available again for charging assignments.
failure_conditions: Charger remains enabled when you intended it to be disabled (other AGVs may be routed to that charger).
Charger remains disabled after manual charging (reduced charging capacity, especially on sites with limited chargers).
Unable to re-enable the charger after manual charging.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot re-enable the charger after manual charging, escalate to support.

missing_details: The packet does not provide the exact UI labels/buttons for 'disable' and 'enable' within Charger Selection (only the concept of a disabled function/control).
The packet does not provide a specific method to confirm that RMS has stopped routing AGVs to the disabled charger beyond re-checking the charger disabled state in Charger Selection.
